items.title: The complex attached to the canonical extension object is acyclic
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-homology-extension at source lines 3873-3880: for an abelian category, an object A and an integer k, the complex s(E) attached to the object E constructed in the author's extension lemma is acyclic. The proof at source lines 3882-3931 is an explicit contracting homotopy. It first defines an extension operation on the simplex maps into [k+1], by extending a map on [n] to [n+1] fixing the new top element, then analyses how the components of E behave according to the image of the map, constructs a system of maps h_n between consecutive degrees, verifies the required identities with the differential (where the sign (-1)^(n+1) is needed) and concludes acyclicity by exhibiting the homotopy. The final sentence names a result of the Homology chapter as an alternative way to conclude; that reference is declared as a source pointer from the project tag list, while the counted argument exhibits the homotopy explicitly and uses nothing outside the retained spans.
